# OKRs — H2 2026

Outcome-oriented objectives for the second half of 2026. Owners are the accountable
leaders; `current` and `confidence` are refreshed at the monthly business review.

## Objective 1 — Restore margin by lifting plant productivity across the network

| key result | baseline | target | current | confidence | owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Blended network OEE | 70% | 85% | 72% | Medium | Sandra Kim |
| Pump & valve scrap rate | 3.8% | <2.5% | 3.4% | Medium | Arjun Rao |
| Hold weekly OEE-by-plant reviews across all four plants | — | every plant, weekly | cadence started | High | Sandra Kim |
